aspectran.description: Aspectran configuration to inject web security response headers.

aspect.description: |Aspect to inject security response headers specifically for HTML view requests. |- Declaratively triggered only for browser HTML page requests matching the 'Accept=text/html' joinpoint header condition. |- Configures X-Frame-Options (SAMEORIGIN), X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff), X-XSS-Protection, and Referrer-Policy. |- Configures Content-Security-Policy (CSP) to mitigate XSS attacks and permit trusted external CDN/font domains (jsdelivr, jquery, googleapis, gstatic).

headers.item: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws: wss: localhost:* 127.0.0.1:*; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' cdn.jsdelivr.net code.jquery.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' localhost:* cdn.jsdelivr.net code.jquery.com fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data: cdn.jsdelivr.net code.jquery.com; font-src 'self' data: cdn.jsdelivr.net fonts.gstatic.com;
